subject: CONGRATULATIONS!! YOU WON $1,000,000 CASH PRIZE!!
body: Dear Lucky Winner!! Your email address has been selected as the grand prize winner of one million dollars in our international promo lottery!! CLICK HERE NOW to claim your earnings before they expire!!

result.reasoning: The email claims the recipient won a $1,000,000 lottery prize and urges immediate action via a click link, typical of unsolicited scam messages with deceptive promises, matching spam characteristics.

subject: Newsletter Issue rgb(68, 67, 17): The Evolution of Computing Architectures
body: Welcome back to your weekly digest. In this issue, we take a deep dive into historical computer science breakthroughs, reverse engineering classic codebases, and how early engineering principles still impact modern application setups.

result.reasoning: The email is a newsletter, explicitly described as a weekly digest about computing topics, matching the definition of a promotional newsletter.

subject: Promo: 30% Off All Gym Equipment & Home Gear
body: Get ready for summer! Upgrade your home setup with our seasonal promotion. Use coupon code FIT30 at checkout to get 30% off weights, resistance bands, and activewear. Free shipping on all orders over $50.

result.reasoning: The email advertises a discount (30% off) with a coupon code, mentions free shipping, and uses promotional language, indicating a marketing offer.

subject: Your Order #112-4938821 Has Been Shipped
body: Hi, your order has been dispatched and is on its way. Estimated delivery is Thursday May 22nd. Track your package using the link below. Thank you for shopping with us.

result.reasoning: The email notifies the recipient that a purchased order has been shipped, providing tracking details and delivery estimate, which is a transactional update.

subject: Your Netflix Invoice for May 2026
body: Your monthly subscription of $15.99 has been charged to your card ending in 4242. Your next billing date is June 1st 2026. If you have any questions about your bill please visit our help center.

result.reasoning: The email provides a subscription charge amount, payment details, and next billing date, which are typical receipt/transaction information, not personal or promotional content.

subject: Eid plans this year?
body: Assalamualaikum! Have you thought about what we are doing for Eid this year? Mama wants everyone to come home. Let me know if you can make it, would love to have the whole family together.

result.reasoning: The email is a friendly greeting asking about family Eid plans and inviting the recipient to a family gathering, indicating a personal relationship.

subject: Stories for you: AI Engineering, System Design, and Startups
body: Based on your reading history we have curated today's top stories. Featuring: Why RAG pipelines fail in production, founding lessons from YC alumni, and a deep dive into distributed systems design patterns.

result.reasoning: The email is a curated content newsletter sent based on reading history, promoting articles and encouraging engagement, with no personal or transactional purpose.

subject: URGENT: Your wallet is at risk. Verify immediately.
body: We have detected suspicious activity on your crypto wallet. You must verify your seed phrase immediately to prevent loss of funds. Click the secure link below and enter your details to protect your assets now.

result.reasoning: The email claims urgent suspicious activity on a crypto wallet and asks the recipient to click a link and provide seed phrase, which is a typical phishing/scam attempt, fitting the SPAM category.

subject: New Arrivals + Members Get Early Access
body: The new summer collection just dropped. As a Nike member you get 24 hour early access before it goes public. Shop the latest running shoes, training gear, and lifestyle apparel. Free returns on every order.

result.reasoning: The email advertises new summer collection, offers early access for members, and encourages shopping, which is clearly a marketing promotion.

subject: Your repository inbox-manager was starred by 3 users
body: Hi, your repository inbox-manager received 3 new stars in the past 24 hours. Keep building great things. View your repository activity and engagement stats from your GitHub dashboard.

result.reasoning: The email notifies the user of repository activity (stars received) and directs them to view stats on the GitHub dashboard, which is a transactional/notification message, not personal, promotional, or spam.

subject: Your Certificate of Completion is Ready
body: Congratulations! You have successfully completed Machine Learning Specialization. Your certificate is now available for download. Share it on LinkedIn and explore our next recommended courses to continue your learning journey.

result.reasoning: The email notifies the recipient that their certificate is ready for download, a transactional update about course completion, with a brief promotional suggestion but primary purpose is informational.

subject: Check out this AI tool I found
body: Bro you have to try this new AI coding assistant I found. It is genuinely insane for building agents. Here is the link. Let me know what you think, I have been using it all week.

result.reasoning: The email is a casual recommendation from a friend, using informal language (“Bro”) and asking for opinion, without promotional sales language; thus it is personal correspondence.

subject: Your Weekly Writing Report is Here
body: You wrote 4,200 words this week and your tone was mostly confident. You also unlocked the Advanced Clarity badge. Upgrade to Grammarly Premium today to get full access to our tone and rewrite suggestions.

result.reasoning: The email provides a personal usage summary but primarily encourages the recipient to upgrade to a paid service, using promotional language typical of marketing communications.

subject: Exclusive Investment Opportunity - Limited Spots
body: Dear Friend, I am reaching out personally to offer you a rare chance to invest in a high return offshore fund. Only 10 spots remain. Send your details and initial deposit to secure your position today.

result.reasoning: The email is an unsolicited investment pitch promising high returns, requesting personal details and an upfront deposit, which is deceptive and potentially harmful, matching the SPAM category.

subject: Security Alert: New sign-in to your Google Account
body: We noticed a new sign-in to your Google Account from a Windows device in Karachi, Pakistan. If this was you, you do not need to take any action. If you do not recognize this activity please secure your account immediately.

result.reasoning: The email notifies the recipient of a security-related account activity and advises action, which is a typical account‑security notification, i.e., an informational/transactional message.
